projectDescription: A browser-based emulator that runs classic Macintosh (and NeXT) operating systems from the 1980s through the early 2000s, powered by WebAssembly emulator cores and served via Cloudflare Workers.
keyFeatures: Instant in-browser emulation of classic Mac OS (System 1 through Mac OS X 10.4) and NeXTSTEP
Multiple emulator cores: Basilisk II, SheepShaver, Mini vMac, DingusPPC, Previous, PearPC, Snow
Large pre-built software library (Infinite HD) and Macintosh Garden integration
CD-ROM library with browseable and mountable disc images
AppleTalk networking between emulator instances via Cloudflare Workers
Embeddable via iframe with a full postMessage control API
Custom configurations: choose machine, RAM size, screen resolution, and disk images
Saved HD for persistent storage across sessions
File drag-and-drop with resource fork support
Deployed on Cloudflare Workers with R2 storage for disk images
publicApiSurface: EmbedControlEvent (emulator_pause, emulator_unpause, emulator_mouse_move, emulator_mouse_down, emulator_mouse_up, emulator_key_down, emulator_key_up, emulator_load_disk)
RunDef type (machine, ramSize, screenSize, disks, diskFiles, cdromURLs, ethernetProvider, flags, settings, ...)
ScreenSize type (auto | fullscreen | window | embed | {width, height})
URL query parameters: disk, machine, ram, screenSize, screen_scale, cdrom, cdrom_url, infinite_hd, saved_hd, library, appleTalk, paused, auto_pause, screen_update_messages, blue_scsi, settings, date
npm run start — local dev server
npm run import-disks — build disk images
npm run import-cd-roms — build CD-ROM library
npm run import-library — build software library
npm run import-emulator <name> — copy WASM emulator binary
npm run worker-deploy — deploy to Cloudflare Workers
npm run sync-disks — sync disk images to R2
